facts.text: The hotel is off Reforma Boulevard in the Polanco neighborhood, known for chic shops, culture and nightlife.
facts.excerpt: W Mexico City is located off Reforma Boulevard in the stylish Polanco neighborhood where trend-seekers meet to explore chic shops, a fast-paced cultural landscape and tempting nightlife.

facts.text: The hotel is next to Lincoln Park in Polanco, within easy walking distance of Avenida Presidente Masaryk and its high-end boutiques.
facts.excerpt: It’s very conveniently located next to Lincoln Park in Polanco. Within easy walking distance to Avenida Presidente Masaryk, which is known for its high-end boutiques

facts.text: The spa has a Temazcal, an ancient pre-Hispanic ritual.
facts.excerpt: Temazcal Ritual: A return to the footprint of our ancestors. An ancient pre-Hispanic ritual, considered a blessing and a form of detachment from all kinds of negative energy.

facts.text: AWAY Spa offers massages, aromatherapy, hot stone and European-style therapy, and a steam room.
facts.excerpt: Kick back and relax at our Mexico City hotel with a gym and spa offering an energizing massage, stimulating aromatherapy, or hot stone or European-style therapy.

facts.text: The spa offers a mixed hydrotherapy circuit.
facts.excerpt: Discover personalized massages, facials, and tailored rituals, a mixed hydrotherapy circuit, and the standout feature that makes it truly distinctive: Mexico's ancient pre-Hispanic heritage showcased in a Temazcal.

facts.text: Every room has quirky touches such as an oversized mural by Mexican artist Ivan Aguirre and an infinity mirror above the bed filled with alebrijes and miniature toys.
facts.excerpt: Every room features fun and quirky touches, from an oversized mural by Mexican artist Ivan Aguirre to an infinity mirror installation over the bed filled with traditional Mexican crafts called alebrijes and miniature toys.

facts.text: Bathrooms have floor-to-ceiling black-and-white tile and natural light.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms offer floor-to-ceiling black-and-white tile and benefit from natural light

facts.text: Rooms have the signature W bed with a down duvet and 350-thread-count linens.
facts.excerpt: Take it easy in Polanco on a signature W bed with a down duvet and 350-thread-count linens.

facts.text: Public spaces are dimly lit with pops of color, neon backlighting and abstract furniture such as oversized busts used as lobby seating.
facts.excerpt: Dimly lit public spaces infused with bright pops of color, neon backlighting, and abstract, conversation-starting furniture shaped as oversized busts repurposed as lobby seating
